issues.legal_issue: An entry adding property to a public trust register does not determine or defeat the title of a person who claims ownership adverse to the trust and was not entitled to participate in the registration inquiry.
material_facts: Property was added to the register as belonging to a public trust after an application by the trust’s trustee.
The respondent claimed title to the property adverse to the trust, rather than claiming an interest in the trust.
The registration inquiry concerned the public or private status of the trust and matters relating to the trust; the respondent was not a party and could not file objections in that inquiry.
The respondent did not appeal the Registrar’s order or bring a suit challenging it.
issues.conclusion: The registration entry could not affect the respondent’s title. Because the respondent was not a party and could not participate in the inquiry, it was not bound to appeal or bring a suit within the prescribed time, and the entry’s statutory finality could not be used against it.
issues.legal_principle: Under the Madhya Pradesh Public Trusts Act, 1951, sections 4(3), 4(5), 5(1)–(2), 6, 7(2), 8(1), and 9(2)–(3), the Registrar conducts a summary inquiry into matters concerning a public trust, including whether it is public or private and which property is trust property. The inquiry does not determine a private person’s adverse claim that the property is not trust property. The notice and objection process concerns persons interested in the trust, and the appeal and suit provisions apply to persons who could participate in, or were parties to, the proceedings. Accordingly, statutory finality does not bind an adverse claimant who was excluded from the inquiry. No earlier cases are relied on.

rule.if: public_trust_registration_proceeding and property_added_to_trust_register and claimant_asserted_adverse_ownership and claimant_not_entitled_to_participate

predicates.public_trust_registration_proceeding: An authority conducted a proceeding to register a trust or make an entry concerning property as belonging to a public trust.
predicates.property_added_to_trust_register: The authority added the disputed property to the register as property of the trust.
predicates.claimant_asserted_adverse_ownership: A person claimed ownership of the property adverse to the trust, rather than claiming an interest in the trust.
predicates.claimant_not_entitled_to_participate: The person claiming adverse ownership was not within the class entitled to participate in the registration inquiry or file objections in it.
predicates.adverse_title_unaffected_by_register_ent: The register entry does not determine or defeat the title claimed adverse to the trust.

issues.definition: When a property is entered in a public trust register and a person claiming it adversely to the trust was not entitled to participate in the registration proceeding, the entry does not determine or defeat that person’s title.
